 Gautam Gulati's brother ranked Priyanka Chahar Choudhary No. 1 on Rise & Fall Season 2. He said her rivalry with the actor keeps the game interesting.
 Advertisement Rise and Fall 2 recent episodes saw visits by family members. (Credit: MX Player) By: India Today Entertainment Desk New Delhi , Oct 26, 2026 17:12 IST Last Updated Oct 26, 2026 17:12 IST Published by Priyanka Sharma Oct 26, 2026 17:12 IST Gautam Gulati’s brother placed Priyanka Chahar Choudhary at No. 1, saying her rivalry with Gautam kept the game interesting. The family visits brought emotion, advice and fresh tensions to Rise & Fall Season 2 , with contestants meeting loved ones after the Lift offered reunions in exchange for prize money. The visits also brought new rankings into the Tower.
 The episode also saw Irina reunite with her friend Samyukta Hegde, who called Swara the biggest manipulator. Meanwhile, Gautam and Manish exchanged personal remarks, medals sparked disagreements among the Rulers, and Irina’s feud with Shehzad escalated from a heated argument to her throwing water at him.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Gautam’s brother caught the Rulers’ attention when he entered the Penthouse because of his strong resemblance to the actor. The brothers shared a few light-hearted moments before turning their attention to the competition.
 He advised Gautam not to be too nice to everyone and gave him a reality check about his approach to the game. Gautam, in turn, nudged his brother to appreciate Priyanka’s gameplay. The exchange left the others wondering whether Gautam and Priyanka shared a genuine friendship or were making a calculated move.
 Gautam’s brother then announced his ranking of the Rulers. Priyanka took first place, followed by Manish at No. 2, Niharika at No. 3, Sonam at No. 4, Rishabh at No. 5 and Jashwanth at No. 6.
 He said he wanted Priyanka at the top because her rivalry with Gautam kept the game alive. As he put it, every hero needs a villain. Sonam, however, was not entirely convinced by the rankings.
 Family reunions bring contrasting rankings
 The latest visits followed other emotional reunion s arranged through the Lift. The Rulers and Workers had to decide how much prize money they were willing to pay for each meeting. Priyanka broke down before her brothers and said she felt cornered in the Tower. The reunion later became tense when remarks by Shehzad upset her family.
 Priyanka’s brother asked Shehzad to maintain his dignity, but Shehzad responded sharply, leading to a confrontation. Her brothers later ranked Niharika first, Manish second and Priyanka third. Jashwanth, Rishabh and Sonam took the fourth, fifth and sixth places, respectively.
 Niharika also became emotional when her mother entered the Tower. Her mother expressed pride in her journey and asked her to remain focused. She ranked Priyanka first, Jashwanth second and Niharika third, followed by Manish, Sonam and Rishabh.
 Jashwanth’s father lightened the mood during his visit before placing Niharika first and Manish second. Jashwanth was ranked third, followed by Sonam, Priyanka and Rishabh. Niharika therefore topped the lists prepared by Priyanka’s brothers and Jashwanth’s father, while Priyanka secured first place in the ranking given by Niharika’s mother. Samyukta calls Swara the biggest manipulator
 While Gautam’s brother visited the Penthouse, Irina welcomed her friend Samyukta Hegde in the Basement. The warm reunion soon took an uncomfortable turn when Samyukta called Swara the biggest manipulator and asked Irina to consider who truly supported her.
 advertisement Samyukta confronted Swara over what she viewed as underhanded tactics. She also acknowledged the gameplay of Priyanka and Niharika. The reunion was bittersweet for Irina, who was heartbroken because she could not meet her mother.
 Samyukta placed Niharika first in her ranking, followed by Priyanka, Rishabh, Jashwanth, Manish and Sonam. The lists gave the contestants another view of how people outside the Tower assessed their games and provided fresh material for debate. Gautam and Manish trade personal remarks
 Tension rose in the Penthouse when Gautam asked Manish and Sonam whom they wanted to see fall. Manish said he wanted to keep game-related discussions aside on family day, but Gautam continued to take jabs at him.
 Manish eventually lost his patience. Both contestants made remarks about each other’s attitudes and appearances as the argument escalated. Gautam called Manish a bully, while Manish described Gautam as the most unpleasant person in the Tower.
 Gautam later tried to end the argument with a hug. The gesture, however, did little to ease the tension after their exchange of personal remarks. advertisement Medals trigger another disagreement
 A special box of medals arrived for the Rulers after the latest Takhta Palat. Gautam took charge of announcing the titles but stumbled while reading them. Shehzad used the mistake to take a dig at the Ultimate Ruler.
 Irina questioned Shehzad’s hostility and reminded him that he had also stumbled over his words in the past. The medals named Priyanka the Ruttbedaar Ruler, Jashwanth the Most Stylish Ruler, Niharika the Smartest Ruler, Manish the Most Competitive Ruler and Gautam the Most Entertaining Ruler.
 The titles soon caused another disagreement. Swara suggested that Niharika could also have been considered for the style award, but Shehzad dismissed the idea as tacky. Irina reacted immediately, adding to the tension between them.
 Irina throws water at Shehzad
 The disagreement between Irina and Shehzad developed into a heated showdown. Irina lost her temper and grabbed a tray, prompting the other contestants to intervene.
 The confrontation continued in the Basement. After another dig from Shehzad, Irina retaliated by throwing water at him. Their bitter exchange left the other contestants dealing with another conflict in the Tower.
